tmp:0497: ahavah nefulah — 'fallen love': love broken/degraded into evil loves via the shattering of the vessels, equated with disgrace and the foreskin of the heart (Gen 34:14)
tmp:0498: shoresh ha-chasadim she-ba-Da'at — kabbalistic root of the Chasadim (kindnesses) within the sefirah Da'at, the source from which illumination is drawn in the lulav kavvanot
tmp:0499: ahavah she-ba-Da'at — the supernal love located in Da'at, above time and the middot, in which Chesed is rooted
tmp:0502: the person who keeps silent (macharish) under insult — an action-state through which one attains the aspect of the Name Ehyeh (Ps 50:21)
tmp:0503: kodem ha-teshuvah — the temporal state 'before repentance,' when Ehyeh remains hidden since one has not yet prepared himself to exist
tmp:0504: Ehyeh in hastarat panim — the divine Name Ehyeh ('I will be') concealed from a person prior to teshuvah, its face hidden from him
tmp:0506: ohel — the Tent (of Meeting, from which Yehoshua departed not; Ex 33:11), symbolizing the firmament stretched 'like a tent' (Isa 40:22), the vav within the letter alef
tmp:0507: be-ne'emnei — 'the faithful [of the land]' (Ps 101:6), midrashically identified as Aharon the priest, aspect of mishpat/judgment
tmp:0510: avvazei — the geese of Rabbah bar bar Chanah's desert tale (Bava Batra 73b), dream-symbol of wisdom ('one who sees a goose in a dream anticipates chokhmah,' Berakhot 57a)
tmp:0511: one's enemies falling before him — the defeat of accusers/adversaries achieved through fasting, which nullifies the liver-anger that arouses Esav/Edom the accuser
tmp:0512: the practice of giving tzedakah to ever more people — each additional recipient enlarges the expanse of still, pure air formed by mutual love
tmp:0513: acquiring friends and lovers through charity — tzedakah as 'storing up souls' (Munbaz, Bava Batra 11a), gaining ohavim whose love purifies the air
tmp:0515: the ability to sing and thank God ('azamrah le-Elokai be-odi,' Ps 146:2) — praise made possible by the 'od,' the remaining good point one finds in oneself
tmp:0519: 'mi-merchak yeda' — 'He knows from afar' (Ps 138:6), scriptural phrase denoting or chozer, the reflected/returning light of perception
tmp:0522: the outgoing extension of the visual ray from the eyes to the seen object — the optical model of or yashar, direct light
tmp:0523: the light that shines to a person toward teshuvah — divine illumination (linked to Shaddai/'enough') that awakens him to return
tmp:0527: the state of intense shame visibly revealed on one's face — embarrassment before the King that manifests after knowledge grows
tmp:0528: or ha-tefillin — the 'light of the tefillin,' the radiance on the face identified with holy shame/bushah revealed upon the countenance
tmp:0530: or malei — 'full light,' the complete spelling of me'orot attained by the contented tzaddik ('wraps in light as a garment,' Ps 104:2), opposite the deficient me'erat of the wicked
tmp:0534: the Four Species (lulav, etrog, myrtle, willow) of Sukkot — the festival's fourfold set paralleling the four cups and fourfold Mishnah review
tmp:0535: the Four Cups of wine at the Pesach seder — Pesach's instance of the fourfold pattern present in each pilgrimage festival
tmp:0536: hevel peh — the breath of the mouth, symbol of the letter Heh (vs. the voice as vav) in Torah study and prayer
tmp:0538: da'at Hashem — knowledge of God Himself (beyond human knowledge), the aspect of the letter heh; lacking it one is a 'minor' who cannot beget
tmp:0540: Tzeva'ot — the divine Name 'of Hosts,' expounded as 'He is an ot (sign/letter) within His host'
tmp:0542: the drawing-down (hamshakhah) from intellect to fear of God — the connecting flow symbolized by the letter vav, the diagonal stroke of the alef
tmp:0544: ha-olam — the created world itself, aspect of the letter vav since it was created in six days (paired with Torah as yud)
tmp:0545: vavei ha-amudim — 'the hooks of the pillars' (Ex 27:10), title for Israel as supporters of the Torah, embodying the letter vav
tmp:0549: Aseret ha-Dibrot — the Ten Commandments, the yud-point of the melupum vowel atop the six-by-six Tablets (vav)
tmp:0552: mem setumah — the closed final-mem letterform composed of the womb's two dalet-doors (Job 3:10), chamber of the fetus and the 40 days of its formation
tmp:0555: 'samkhuni' — 'sustain me' (Song 2:5), word expounded as the letter samekh (support), aspect of prayer
tmp:0556: ha-olamot — the worlds that fell in the shattering of the vessels at creation, which are constituted of letters scattered into sparks
tmp:0559: subduing one's evil inclination (kofeh et yitzro) — the act that makes the rav 'like an angel of Hashem Tzeva'ot,' a mighty one who does His word
tmp:0561: the letters present within every created thing — deriving from the 32 'Elokim' of the creation account, source of the heart's (lev=32) illumination
tmp:0562: shevirah — the kabbalistic Breaking of the Vessels, understood as letters that shattered and fell into every thing of this world
tmp:0563: the eleven spices of the ketoret (incense) — symbol of the holy sparks rising from among the idolatrous nations, linked to cutting off Amalek's seed
tmp:0564: kesher shel tefillin — the knot of the head-tefillin at the back, what Moshe was shown as God's 'back' (Berakhot 7a)
tmp:0565: achorai — 'My back' (Ex 33:23), the divine hind-aspect revealed to Moshe, identified with the tefillin knot
tmp:0567: the disciple who draws near the tzaddik yet 'cuts the saplings' and denies all — the heretic-type of Acher (Elisha ben Avuyah), with filth in his heart
tmp:0571: shayish tahor — the 'pure marble' of the Pardes ascent (Chagigah 14b), symbol of existence after actualization (yesh), when 'pure' applies
tmp:0576: lo — the word 'not' (Jer 23:24) as symbol of ayin, nothingness/naught, God's self-showing in humility to the one who hides himself in lowliness
